attacks.name: Throwing Knife
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains 1 |!power|.
The defender does not benefit from Cover.
|!wild| |*Bleed|: After this attack is resolved, the target character gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.

attacks.name: Pin Cushion
steps: The defender does not benefit from Cover.
After this attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§bleed§Bleed| special condition.

|*Rapid Fire|: After this attack is resolved, this character may make an additional |*Pin Cushion| attack without paying the |!power| cost. The additional attack must target the original defender. The additional attack does not have the |*Rapid Fire| special rule.

superPowers.name: Hit and Run
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character immediately makes an attack action followed by a move action. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: I Never Miss
superPowers.body: After an attack made by this character is resolved, if no |!damage| was dealt as a result of that attack, this character may use this superpower. The defender suffers 1 |!damage|.

superPowers.name: Parting Shot
superPowers.body: After an attack targeting this character is resolved, this character may use this superpower. The attacking character suffers 1 |!damage|. This character may Advance Away from the attacking character |!range_small|.
